name: projects_list
title: List projects
description: Lists or finds BitterClip projects/shows visible to this person, including projects shared with them. It resolves a named show/project, a project shared by another account, or the project_id for a shared shell, ahead of recordings_list or episodes_list. query filters by project title, description, or owning studio; multi-word queries tolerate punctuation differences (for example, "andrew adrian" can match "andrew & adrian"). Returned project_id values can be passed directly to recordings_list, episodes_list, and upload tools. workspace_open opens a Project with target_type:"project" and that project_id as target_id.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive filter across project title, description, owning studio name, and relationship (owned/shared).

examples.label: Find a shared show by name
